quote: This Act, and the amendments made by this Act, shall apply with respect to any dispute or claim that arises or accrues on or after the date of enactment of this Act.
why: Section 3 limits the amendments to disputes or claims arising or accruing on or after enactment (March 3, 2022).
Section 5408 adds 42 U.S.C. 1101(c)(5) with no effective-date or applicability provision, so it takes effect on approval, August 5, 1997.
Section 12(a) amends 49 U.S.C. 60101(a) without any effective-date provision, so it takes effect on approval, June 22, 2016.

quote: The amendments made by this section shall take effect upon the date of the enactment of this Act and shall apply to proceedings commenced on or after that date.
why: Section 15(c) applies the best-mode amendment of section 282 only to proceedings commenced on or after enactment; section 20(g)'s technical amendments to 282 take effect one year later under 20(l), again for proceedings commenced on or after that date.

quote: The amendments made by this section shall apply to sales after September 30, 2005.
why: Section 11112(b) applies the light-tractor exclusion only to sales after September 30, 2005, a date after enactment (August 10, 2005).

quote: Effective 15 days after the enactment of the Sustainable Fisheries Act, all references to the Magnuson Fishery Conservation and Management Act shall be redesignated as references to the Magnuson-Stevens Fishery Conservation and Management Act.
why: Title II section 211(b) delays the name change to 15 days after the Sustainable Fisheries Act's enactment (October 11, 1996), a date after this law's approval, with no reach back.
Sections 201, 202(b) and 207 amend 28 U.S.C. 636 with no effective-date or applicability provision covering them, so they take effect on approval, October 19, 1996.

quote: shall take effect upon the expiration of the 90-day period beginning on the date of the enactment of this Act; and (2) shall apply to-- (A) petitions for certification filed under chapter 2, 3, or 6 of title II of the Trade Act of 1974 on or after the effective date
why: Section 1891(a) makes section 1882's amendment of 19 U.S.C. 2401a effective 90 days after enactment and applies it only to petitions filed on or after that date.

quote: The amendments made by this section shall take effect on the date of enactment of this Act and shall apply to conduct on or after the date of enactment
why: Section 4(f) limits section 4's amendments, including 4(d) to 31 U.S.C. 3730(h), to conduct on or after enactment; its exceptions cover only sections 3729(a)(1)(B), 3731(b), 3732 and 3733.
Section 4(b)(1) makes a conforming amendment to 12 U.S.C. 1822(f)(3) with no effective-date provision, so it takes effect on approval, August 6, 1996.
